scoring_justification: T1 recompute: critical forces/deformations are derived from force-deformation CSVs by locating the maximum; the crossing deformation is interpolated from the von Mises stress profiles; trends (I1_top decreasing, I1_side increasing) are verified directly from the submitted stress_profiles_300K.csv.

outputs.description: Stress invariant and von Mises stress profiles for top and side capsid portions at T=300 K, as functions of deformation. The checker will recompute the crossing deformation and verify trend shapes.
Force-deformation curve from the T=300 K nanoindentation simulation. The checker will recompute the maximum force and the corresponding deformation.
Force-deformation curve from the T=0 K nanoindentation simulation. The checker will recompute the maximum force and the corresponding deformation.
Compiled critical quantities: collapse forces and deformations at both temperatures, and the crossing deformation for von Mises stress.

output_contract.notes: The force-deformation curves are extracted directly from the simulation output. Stress profiles are derived from TensorCalculator output. The checker will verify that the stress profiles show the expected trend (I1_top decreasing, I1_side slightly increasing) and that the crossing deformation is within tolerance. Critical forces and deformations are compared to paper-reported values.

hidden_assets.purpose: gold values for critical force, deformation, and crossing deformation
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper figures and text: critical force 300K ~0.65 nN, critical deformation ~9.5 nm (Figure 3a, text); critical force 0K ~2.25 nN (Figure 3a); crossing von Mises deformation ~7.2 nm (Figure 5, text).
hidden_assets.generation_method: extracted directly from the paper's reported values.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual numbers reported by the authors for the two-fold axis nanoindentation and the von Mises crossing criterion; they constitute the reproduction target.

steps.description: Recompute the maximum force and the deformation at which it occurs from the force-deformation curve; compare to paper gold.
Recompute the maximum force and the deformation at collapse from the 0 K curve; compare to paper gold.
Interpolate the deformation where vM_top equals vM_side; verify that I1_top decreases and I1_side increases with deformation.
Check that the values in results.json are consistent with the recomputed quantities from the raw CSV files.
